# Source version audit

<!-- Generated by `make gen-version-audit`. Do not edit; regenerate. -->

How much of each source's release history the committed adapter fixtures cover.
`TestKeyPathCoverage` answers whether every observed field is classified; this
answers whether enough has been observed to make that answer worth much.

A source's version kind says what its version measures. A **producer** version
moves when the agent ships and is the axis a shape change travels along. A
**schema** version is the on-disk format revision, which moves independently and
far more slowly; stratifying by it would give one bucket on the wrong axis.
**none** means the source records no version at all, so its coverage is
unstratified and known to be.

Version-stratified coverage records what has been seen, never what exists. It
converts an unknown gap into a recorded one; it does not watch upstream
releases.
